"""Reduce the completed small-model repair screen; the large-model screen remains pending."""

import copy
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import time


HELPER = Path('/tmp/summarize_sparsemax_repairs.py')
HELPERS = runpy.run_path(str(HELPER))
ROOT = HELPERS['ROOT']
CANDIDATES = ('qknorm-one', 'scaleddot')


def collect():
    state = json.loads(Path('/tmp/basis-sparsemax-step4-supervisor.json').read_text())
    if state['phase'] not in ('large', 'complete'):
        raise ValueError('The repair supervisor has not completed all small runs')
    baselines, baseline_sources = {}, {}
    for name in ('small_results.json', 'large_results.json'):
        path = ROOT / name
        baselines.update(json.loads(path.read_text())['runs'])
        baseline_sources[name] = HELPERS['sha'](path)
    runs, comparisons, runtime_code = {}, {}, None
    for label in (state['small_outcomes'] if state['phase'] == 'large' else {label: run for label, run in state['outcomes'].items() if '-small-' in label}):
        run = HELPERS['trajectory'](label)
        frames = run['trajectory']
        description = run['description']
        metadata = json.loads((ROOT / 'runs' / label / 'experiment.json').read_text())
        for segment in metadata['segments']:
            code = segment['provenance']['engine']['code']
            if runtime_code is None:
                runtime_code = code
            assert code == runtime_code, f'Runtime source drift in {label}'
            assert segment['source_sha256'] == HELPERS['sha'](ROOT / 'experiment.py')
        run['runtime_source_code_verified'] = True
        candidate = next(name for name in CANDIDATES if label.startswith(f'repair-{name}-'))
        original_label = label.removeprefix(f'repair-{candidate}-')
        control_label = f'sparsemax-{original_label}'
        expected = copy.deepcopy(json.loads((ROOT / 'runs' / control_label / 'experiment.json').read_text())['description'])
        expected['model']['block']['attention']['scores'] = (
            {**expected['model']['block']['attention']['scores'], 'initial_scale': 1.0}
            if candidate == 'qknorm-one' else {'type': 'ScaledDot'})
        expected['diagnostics']['type'] = 'AttentionDiagnostics'
        expected['diagnostics']['examples'] = 256
        assert description == expected, f'Unexpected description change in {label}'
        run['description_comparison'] = {'control_label': control_label,
            'verified_only_changes': ['model.block.attention.scores', 'diagnostics.type', 'diagnostics.examples']}
        assert description['model']['block']['attention']['weights']['type'] == 'Sparsemax'
        scores = description['model']['block']['attention']['scores']
        assert scores['type'] == ('QKNorm' if candidate == 'qknorm-one' else 'ScaledDot')
        if candidate == 'qknorm-one':
            assert scores['initial_scale'] == 1.0
        assert all(frame['examples'] == 256 and frame['split'] == run['selection'] for frame in frames)
        assert not any(frame['diagnostic_probe'] for frame in frames)
        cadence = description['evaluate']['every']
        assert [frame['step'] for frame in frames] == list(range(0, run['stop']['step'] + 1, cadence))
        with (ROOT / 'runs' / label / 'diagnostics.jsonl').open() as source:
            last = None
            for line in source:
                last = json.loads(line)
        assert last['step'] == run['stop']['step']
        run['last_training_batch_loss'] = last['loss']
        run['final_head_scales'] = last['temperatures']
        passed = [frame['step'] for frame in frames if frame['selection_sequence_accuracy'] >= .99]
        run['pass_step'] = passed[0] if passed else None
        assert (run['pass_step'] is not None) == (run['stop']['reason'] == 'solved')
        final_heads = [head for layer in run['final_heads'].values()
                       for head in layer['actual']['nontrivial_rows'] if head['row_count']]
        run['final_sparsity'] = {
            'mean_support_positions': HELPERS['mean']([head['mean_support_positions'] for head in final_heads]),
            'mean_support_share': HELPERS['mean']([head['mean_support_share'] for head in final_heads]),
            'exact_zero_pair_share': HELPERS['mean']([head['exact_zero_pair_share'] for head in final_heads]),
            'dense_heads': sum(head['exact_zero_pair_share'] == 0 for head in final_heads),
            'total_heads': len(final_heads),
            'has_exact_visible_zeros': any(head['exact_zero_pair_share'] > 0 for head in final_heads),
        }
        soft = baselines[f'softmax-{original_label}']
        sparse = baselines[f'sparsemax-{original_label}']
        for control in (soft, sparse):
            for name, checksum in control['source'].items():
                assert HELPERS['sha'](ROOT / name) == checksum, f'Changed control source: {name}'
        run['comparison'] = {
            'candidate': candidate,
            'softmax_pass_step': soft['pass_step'],
            'sparsemax_pass_step': sparse['pass_step'],
            'required_softmax_pass': soft['pass_step'] is not None,
            'matches_softmax': soft['pass_step'] is None or run['pass_step'] is not None,
        }
        runs[label] = run
    for candidate in CANDIDATES:
        selected = {label: run for label, run in runs.items() if run['comparison']['candidate'] == candidate}
        required = {label: run for label, run in selected.items() if run['comparison']['required_softmax_pass']}
        mismatches = [label for label, run in required.items() if run['pass_step'] is None]
        dense_only = [label for label, run in required.items()
                      if run['pass_step'] is not None and not run['final_sparsity']['has_exact_visible_zeros']]
        comparisons[candidate] = {
            'runs': len(selected), 'required_softmax_passes': len(required),
            'matched_required_passes': len(required) - len(mismatches),
            'all_passes': sum(run['pass_step'] is not None for run in selected.values()),
            'unmatched_softmax_labels': mismatches, 'dense_only_passing_labels': dense_only,
            'passes_basis_repair_criterion': not mismatches and not dense_only,
            'cells': {label: {'pass_step': run['pass_step'],
                             'softmax_pass_step': run['comparison']['softmax_pass_step'],
                             'sparsemax_pass_step': run['comparison']['sparsemax_pass_step'],
                             'best_sequence_accuracy': run['best_sequence_accuracy'],
                             'last_training_batch_loss': run['last_training_batch_loss'],
                             'final_sparsity': run['final_sparsity']}
                      for label, run in selected.items()},
        }
        assert len(selected) == 15 and len(required) == 9
    source = Path(__file__).read_text()
    result = {'collected_utc': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime()),
              'scope': 'Step 4: completed small-model screen only; all large-model conclusions remain pending',
              'criterion': 'Pass every matched softmax seed at selection sequence accuracy >= 0.99, with exact visible zeros',
              'code_commit': state['code_commit'], 'program_source': source,
              'program_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(),
              'helper_source': HELPER.read_text(), 'helper_sha256': HELPERS['sha'](HELPER),
              'baseline_sources': baseline_sources, 'runtime_code_sha256': runtime_code,
              'experiment_source_sha256': HELPERS['sha'](ROOT / 'experiment.py'),
              'comparisons': comparisons, 'runs': runs}
    (ROOT / 'small_repair_results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(comparisons, indent=2), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    collect()
